adjudication.rationale:
The UI-side part is verifiable: `addMembers` in `admin-group.js.es6` has a TODO and does not clear/reset `this.get("usernames")` after adding, so the same usernames remain in the input and a second click will re-submit them.

However, the claimed backend failure (`ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` from unconditional `group.add(user)` in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`) is not directly verifiable from this diff because the implementation of `Group#add` / membership insertion behavior (whether it ignores existing members or rescues uniqueness) is not shown here. The diff does show the server does not explicitly de-dup usernames before calling `group.add(user)`, so it’s a reasonable edge-case concern, but the specific 500/exception is speculative from the provided changes alone.
